title: OpenReading Corpus Report v0.1
description: The output of comparing two or more batch-result envelopes (Manifest v0.6): documents pair across runs by identity (relpath → filename → sha256), each paired document runs the existing comparison-report v0.2, and a rollup summarizes verdicts. A separate family (not a comparison-report `mode`) because that mode enum is CLOSED — adding a value would be MAJOR (Canon §8). schema_version is a per-version const.

subjects.description: The batch runs being compared, in argument order.

backend_tally.description: Per-backend item counts from this run's summary.backends.

verdict.description: CLOSED enum. equivalent/divergent/mixed from the per-document comparison headline; unpaired = the document is present in some runs but not all.

report.description: The full comparison-report v0.2 for this document (validated independently); null when unpaired.

by_finding_code.description: Total finding counts by code across all paired documents.
